Palo Verde Cancer Specialists is dedicated to providing the most advanced and compassionate cancer care available in the Valley. Unlike many other cancer treatment centers, our centers include a comprehensive array of life-saving treatments administered by board-certified hematologists and medical oncologists. Radiation oncology services are available through our Palo Verde partners. Each specialist will walk you through the process, from diagnosis to treatment. Assembling all of these specialists at one center and working with such a multitude of treatment options means you can be confident that you are getting the best possible treatment plan.

Cancer Treatment For The Unique You

There are many types of cancer treatment. The types of treatment that you receive will depend on the type of cancer you have and how advanced it is. Some people with cancer will have only one treatment. But most people have a combination of treatments, such as surgery with chemotherapy and/or radiation therapy. When you need treatment for cancer, you have a lot to learn and think about. It is normal to feel overwhelmed and confused. Talking with the Physicians at Palo Verde Cancer Specialist will help navigate your options and help you feel more in control.

Overcoming cancer…together.

Like the Palo Verde Tree, we believe you are strong, resilient, and important. Likewise, our strength is our combination of cancer specialists and comprehensive lineup of cancer treatment options. Contact our cancer specialists today and find out how we can help you with your battle against cancer. With four convenient locations, you will find our caring and professional staff ready and waiting to navigate you through your total cancer care.

settings.editor:
Palo Verde Cancer Specialists Help You with Compassionate Care

Palo Verde Cancer Specialists provides you compassionate care, and our dedicated oncology clinic team will help create a treatment plan for your specific condition. When you are first diagnosed with cancer, you will most likely feel shocked, overwhelmed, and afraid. Few cancers require emergency treatment, so you have time to get as much information as you can and get a second opinion if you desire, which will help you make informed decisions about your cancer treatment. Palo Verde Cancer Specialists will work with you every step of the way to explore your options and decide on your treatment—that’s why we want to help address some initial questions you may have about cancer.

What is Cancer?

Cancer encompasses a wide range of diseases characterized by the abnormal and uncontrolled growth of cells. These cells can be classified into two main types: benign and malignant. Benign tumors are non-cancerous growths that typically do not invade nearby tissues or spread to other parts of the body. In contrast, malignant tumors are cancerous and have the potential to invade surrounding tissues and metastasize to other organs. Cancer can affect nearly any part of the body and can have various causes, including genetic factors, environmental exposures, and lifestyle choices. Each type of cancer has its own unique characteristics and treatment options.
